findings: Closed iso and right views show one base with one seated lid, eight external screw heads and one unobstructed rectangular display window.
The lid-print iso/top views show two open U supports on the glass-near side, two round supports on the far side, four unchanged outer mounting holes and three registration tabs.
Top and iso views with the removable lid/display subassembly hidden show the controller USB shell aligned to the left open-top notch and the carrier retained on four mounts.
These are rendered clearance envelopes. They do not establish printed dimensions, cable bending, fastener torque or physical assembly.

checks.finding: The closed iso view contains a single two-piece enclosure and one display opening; no duplicate case is visible.
The closed case is a shallow rectangular instrument enclosure; the display occupies the intended right-hand area and the lid follows the base perimeter.
The closed lid exposes the dark display face. The interior top view shows an open-top left USB notch aligned with the controller shell; the lid-print view shows all four display supports.

No disconnected external objects appear in the full closed views. Purchased spacers, board and fastener heads in the interior view follow their mounting stacks; the intentionally hidden lid parts are omitted only for this inspection view.
The lid-print underside shows two U sections and two round posts integral to the lid. Four corner metal spacers and four carrier fasteners appear at the intended board/case mounts.
The glass face points through the upper lid window, the controller connector points toward the left notch, and the print-lid view puts the outer flat face on the bed with supports extending upward.
Closed iso/right views show the same seated lid and body. Lid-print iso/top views agree on support positions, window and corner holes. The interior views expose the same carrier and left USB cutout.
